# REQ: LANG-1531 LANG-1532 LANG-1533
@load base/frameworks/notice

module Demo;

export {
    type Info: record {
        ts: time &log;
        host: addr &log;
        count: count &default=0;
    };
    global greet: function(name: string): string;
}

event connection_established(c: connection) {
    local who = c$id$orig_h;
    if (who in 10.0.0.0/8 && T)
        print fmt("Hello, %s! %d", who, 0x1F);
}
